name: The genus of `y² = f(x)`

name: The groupoid van Kampen theorem

name: The homology of spheres

name: Nonvanishing of `ζ_K` on the line `Re s = 1`

name: Covers are determined by their triples
text: a connected degree-`n` cover of `ℂ ∖ {0, 1}` is determined up to isomorphism by the class of its monodromy triple, and likewise at the numbered and pointed levels. name: Three rigidifications of a cover, as quotient types
text: numbered, pointed and bare covers up to their own isomorphisms, with commuting forgetful maps. Bare classes are the relabelling orbits of numbered classes, and pointed classes are diagonal orbits of numbered classes with a marked label.

name: The Lie-type candidate groups
text: for every valid index, the candidate is the derived subgroup of the Steinberg fixed points modulo its centre. On the thirteen ordinary and graph-twisted constructors the Steinberg map is proved to be `γ ∘ Frob_q`. On the four Suzuki–Ree constructors it is an odd power of a half-Frobenius.

name: The Riemann mapping theorem
text: every nonempty, simply connected, proper open subset of `ℂ` admits a holomorphic bijection onto the unit disc, with normalized and uniqueness forms.

name: Carathéodory's boundary correspondence
text: a Riemann map of a bounded Jordan domain extends to a homeomorphism between the closed disc and the closure of the domain.

name: The Schwarz–Christoffel theorem
text: a bounded simply connected domain with a polygonal Jordan-curve frontier, whose corners may be reentrant, is the image of the upper half-plane under an affine image of the Schwarz–Christoffel primitive, with prevertices sent to vertices.

name: The Schwarz reflection principle
text: a holomorphic function that is real on a symmetric piece of the real axis continues by conjugation, with line, analytic-arc and circle variants.

name: The monodromy theorem

name: The resolution theorem
text: for a resolving subcategory of an exact category, inclusion induces an isomorphism on exact K₀, inverse to the alternating class of any finite resolution; it is natural, equivalence-invariant, and has a graded Laurent version.

name: Cartan unimodularity
text: if every finitely generated module has a finite projective resolution, the Cartan map `K₀(proj A) → G₀(mod A)` is an isomorphism and the Cartan matrix has determinant ±1; the dual numbers, with Cartan matrix `[2]`, show that the hypothesis is needed.

name: The Ext-Euler pairing of a quiver is the Ringel form

name: The sesquilinear q-Euler form
text: `χ_q` descends to the Laurent-module graded K₀, where it is q-antilinear in the first argument and q-linear in the second.

name: The derived comparison
text: abelian K₀ is triangulated K₀ of the bounded derived category, a complex going to the alternating sum of its cohomology classes; the companion result identifies split K₀ with triangulated K₀ of the bounded homotopy category.

name: Deligne's fine conjugation relation
text: conjugation exchanges I^{p,q} and I^{q,p} modulo the sum of the I^{r,s} with r < q and s < p, exactly as Peters–Steenbrink state it.

name: Riemann forms are polarizations
text: for a complex structure J on the realification of a flat lattice, the Riemann forms of J are exactly the forms that polarize its effective weight-one Hodge structure. This is the abelian-variety case of the theory.

name: The Hopf–Rinow theorem
text: for a point `p` of a Riemannian manifold whose metric is the Riemannian distance, five conditions are equivalent: `exp_p` is defined on all of `T_p M`, the manifold is proper, it is complete, every geodesic runs for all time, and it has a compact exhaustion along which distance from `p` diverges. An everywhere-defined `exp_p` also joins `p` to each point by a minimizing geodesic.

name: Compact manifolds are geodesically complete
text: do Carmo's Corollary 2.9. The proof goes through the extended metric, so it needs no connectedness hypothesis.

name: The Gauss lemma
text: the differential of `exp_p` preserves inner products with the radial direction everywhere on its domain.

name: Minimizers in a normal neighbourhood are radial geodesics
text: a curve from the centre that is as short as the radial segment is that segment composed with a nondecreasing surjection of `[0, 1]`.

name: Do Carmo's distance is Mathlib's distance
text: the infimum of lengths over piecewise-`C¹` paths equals `Manifold.riemannianEDist`, by corner smoothing.

name: The Riemann–Roch theorem
text: on a proper integral curve over `k` with discrete-valuation local rings in codimension one and a `k`-rational point, `χ(𝒪_X(D)) = deg D + 1 − g` for every Weil divisor. Its finiteness hypothesis on `H¹(X, 𝒪_X)` is proved separately for such curves.

name: Serre duality for divisor sheaves
text: `H¹(𝒪_X(D))^∨ ≅ H⁰(𝒪_X(K − D))` for a canonical divisor `K` coming from a Weil differential, assuming `k` is integrally closed in `k(X)`. Under the same hypothesis `deg K = 2g − 2`.

name: `Cl(X) ≅ Pic(X)`
text: on a Noetherian integral curve with discrete-valuation local rings in codimension one, `D ↦ 𝒪_X(D)` identifies divisor classes with line-bundle classes.

name: `Cl⁰(X) ≅ Pic⁰(X)`
text: on a proper such curve, the degree-zero divisor classes are exactly the kernel of the Euler-characteristic degree `χ(L) − χ(𝒪_X)`, which agrees with the weighted divisor degree.

name: Krull–Schmidt cancellation over `ℤ_p[G]`
text: a finitely generated `ℤ_p[G]`-module cancels from direct sums, the completeness-dependent cancellation (NSW (5.6.10)(i)) that fails over `ℤ[G]`; nonempty_linearEquiv_of_prod_linearEquiv.

name: Sharp tame-frame exponents
text: for a generating pair `σ, τ` with `τ` of order prime to `p`, there are exponents `a, b` lifting the action on `μ_{p^∞}(L)` such that `ℤ_p[G]/(σ - a, τ - b)` has order exactly `q(L)` and is `ℤ_p[G]`-isomorphic to the torsion of `A(L)`, the exact sequence `(∗)` of NSW (7.4.1); exists_tameFrame_exponents.

name: The torsion of `A(L)`
text: the torsion of the completed unit group is the image of the `p`-power roots of unity and has order `q(L)`; natCard_torsion_padicCompletionUnits.

name: Inflation from the maximal pro-`p` quotient
text: pullback along `G_K → G_K(p)` is an isomorphism on `H¹(-, 𝔽_p)` and injective on `H²`; inflH1AbsoluteGaloisProP, inflH2AbsoluteGaloisProP_injective.

name: The dyadic case split
text: every finite extension of `ℚ₂` lies in exactly one of the four non-free marked branches, and the even branches are separated by whether `-1` lies in the cyclotomic image; dyadic_markedCase_exists_unique.

name: Kantorovich duality with dual attainment on Polish spaces
text: for a bounded continuous nonnegative cost the optimal cost is the greatest value of an integrable dual pair, and some optimal plan is certified by `c`-conjugate potentials; on compact spaces duality also holds for lower semicontinuous costs.

name: The Wasserstein space is a Polish-grade metric space
text: over a Polish base `P_p(X)` is complete and separable, and a family is relatively compact exactly when it is tight with uniformly integrable `p`-moments; on the line `W_p` is the `Lᵖ` distance of quantiles for every `p ∈ [1, ∞]`.

name: Kantorovich–Rubinstein duality
text: for laws with finite first moment on a Polish metric space, `W_1` is the supremum of `∫ f dμ - ∫ f dν` over 1-Lipschitz `f`.

name: The twist theorem
text: if `y ↦ Dₓc(x, y)` is injective and the source potential is differentiable almost everywhere, contact fibres are almost surely singletons, so a certified plan is induced by an a.e.-unique measurable map.

name: Spin is the even unitary group up to dimension five
text: for nondegenerate Q with `1 ≤ dim V ≤ 5`, every even Clifford unit with `reverse x * x = 1` is a Lipschitz element, so Spin(Q) = U(C₀, σ) on the nose.

name: …and not beyond
text: over an infinite field of characteristic not two, Spin is a proper subgroup of U(C₀, σ) in every dimension at least six, with the split rational witness in dimension six.

name: Mathlib's Lipschitz group is the classical Clifford group
text: for a nondegenerate form representing a unit, a Clifford unit lies in the closure-defined carrier exactly when its twisted conjugation preserves the vectors, settling the converse Mathlib's docstring leaves open.

name: The automorphism criterion for conjugated unit powers
text: in a free pro-`p` group of finite rank, sending each basis element `x i` to a conjugate `(c i)⁻¹ x i ^ u i c i` of a unit power always defines a continuous automorphism. This is the step of Layer 2.2 that turns a solution of the product identity into an automorphism, and it is what the reflection and permutation symmetries of Layer 3 need.

name: Generating families come from automorphisms
text: a family that topologically generates a free pro-`p` group of finite rank is the image of the basis under a continuous automorphism. This is the Hopf-type input behind the criterion.

name: Uniqueness of the exponent
text: in positive rank, a peripheral automorphism determines its exponent `u`. So the exponent character of Layer 3 will be well defined.

name: Sₙ is a Galois group over ℚ
text: for every n ≥ 1 there is a monic integral polynomial of degree n, irreducible over ℚ, with full symmetric Galois group. It is built from reductions at 2, 3 and 5.

name: The transitive subgroups of S₅
text: every transitive subgroup of S₅ is conjugate to exactly one of C₅, D₅, F₂₀, A₅ and S₅, and likewise in degrees three and four.

name: The discriminant test
text: away from characteristic 2, a monic separable polynomial has square discriminant exactly when its Galois image consists of even permutations.

name: The quintic solvability criterion
text: an irreducible separable quintic has a solvable Galois group exactly when its separable F₂₀ resolvent sextic has a root in the base field.

name: Soundness of quintic certificates
text: a certificate that checks for a monic integral quintic proves the label it claims, by one of five routes, each with a worked instance.

name: Resolvent specifications

text: for a prime not dividing the discriminant, the factor degrees of f mod p form a full cycle type of the Galois image. It rests on the theorem supplied by Number Field Arithmetic.

name: Trivial intersection of the closed lower central series
text: in a pro-`p` group, the terms `γ_n(G)` intersect in the trivial subgroup.

name: `ẑ` as the inverse limit of the `ZMod n`

text: in a pro-`p` group, taking `p`-adic powers commutes with the bracket in each argument, so the graded pieces are `ℤ_p`-modules and the bracket is bilinear over them.

name: Closedness of conjugacy
text: in a compact Hausdorff group, the set of conjugate pairs is closed in `G × G`.

name: Continuous automorphisms and outer automorphisms

name: Serre's theorem at arbitrary rank
text: a pro-`p` group has `cd_p ≤ 1` exactly when it is free pro-`p` on a pointed profinite space whose generators converge to the identity.

name: The pro-`p` Nielsen–Schreier theorem
text: every closed subgroup of a free pro-`p` group, of any rank, is free pro-`p`. An open subgroup of index `m` in a free group of rank `n` has rank `1 + m(n - 1)`.

name: Labute's Theorem 4

name: The classification of Demushkin groups with `q ≠ 2`
text: at every prime, such a group has Labute's normal form `x₁^q (x₁, x₂) ⋯ (x_{n-1}, x_n)`. It is therefore [determined by its rank and `q`](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/Group/Profinite/Demushkin/NormalForm/Uniqueness.html#TauCeti.IsDemushkin.nonempty_continuousMulEquiv_of_demushkinQ_eq). name: Successive approximation
text: [a relator that agrees with a model modulo the lower `p`-series can be moved onto it by an automorphism](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/Group/Profinite/Free/SuccessiveApproximation/Basic.html#TauCeti.freeProP.exists_continuousMulEquiv_apply_eq_of_range_basisModificationDelta_eq_top), once the graded span conditions hold. name: Labute's relation module
text: TauCeti.labuteE is the abelianized kernel of the orientation, with its completed-group-algebra action. It is the stage for the `q = 2` even-rank arguments. Explicit generators are known in one even-rank branch.

name: Bimultiplicativity of the local Hilbert symbol
text: over a nonarchimedean local field with `2 ≠ 0`, dyadic fields included, `(a, bc)_K = (a, b)_K (a, c)_K`. This follows from the norm group of `K(√a)` having index two for every nonsquare `a`.

name: Every Brauer class is a crossed product
text: each class in `Br(K)` is the class of the crossed product of a 2-cocycle of some finite Galois subextension of `Kˢ/K`.

name: The Witt ring, functorial, with Pfister generators
text: `Iⁿ` is additively generated by `n`-fold Pfister classes, and scalar extension gives ring maps `W(K) → W(L)` that preserve every power of `I`. A homomorphism on `I²` can therefore be defined by its values on generators (TauCeti.fundamentalIdeal_pow_eq_addClosure, TauCeti.WittRing.baseChange).

name: The Scharlau transfer on Witt rings
text: transfer along a nonzero functional respects isometry, satisfies Frobenius reciprocity and the change-of-functional rule, and descends to a `W(K)`-linear map `W(L) → W(K)`.

name: Existence of ordered real closures
text: every ordered field `K` has a real closed, algebraic, order-extending field extension in the same universe, with no countability or Archimedean hypothesis: exists_realClosure.

name: The fundamental theorem of algebra for real closed fields
text: adjoining `√-1` to any real closed field gives an algebraically closed field, so irreducible polynomials have degree at most two: isAlgClosed_quadraticAlgebra.

name: Polynomial IVT and Rolle over real closed fields

name: Faithfully flat morphisms are quotients by their kernels
text: coinvariants_kernelHopfIdeal_eq_range: the functions invariant under the kernel are exactly those pulled back from the target, with no smoothness hypothesis.

name: Happel's theorem
text: the stable category of a Frobenius exact category, with the shift generated by stable suspension and the triangles generated by conflations, is triangulated. The pretriangulated structure is a definition to install locally, not a global instance.

name: Duality of matrix factorizations
text: transposition, with the roadmap's pinned sign, is a contravariant additive functor from factorizations of `w` to factorizations of `-w`, and each factorization is isomorphic to its double dual.

name: Disk factorization of null-homotopies
text: a map of matrix factorizations is null-homotopic exactly when it factors through the disk sum on its source, and contractible factorizations are retracts of disk sums. This is the input for identifying projective-injectives with contractibles in the Frobenius structure.

name: Matrix factorizations inside curved duplexes
text: the homotopy category `HMF(S,w)` embeds fully faithfully in the homotopy category of all curved duplexes of finitely generated modules.

name: Couture's classification of skew-zigzag algebras
text: two skew parameters on a finite graph have the same class in `H¹(G, kˣ)` exactly when their algebras are isomorphic by an isomorphism fixing the vertex idempotents. Graded and up-to-graph-automorphism versions exist as well.

name: Non-Dynkin preprojective algebras are infinite-dimensional
text: for a connected finite graph not isomorphic to a Dynkin diagram, the preprojective algebra of every orientation is infinite-dimensional over every field.

name: Quadratic dual of the zigzag algebra
text: it is the signless preprojective algebra. That algebra agrees with the ordinary preprojective algebra for a bipartite graph, and provably cannot be matched with it by any gauge on a non-bipartite graph when `2 ≠ 0`.

name: Zeroth cohomology of the Ginzburg algebra
text: `H⁰(Π₂(Q)) ≅ Π_k(Q)` as algebras, a doubled path going to the class of the same path.

name: [The homology Cauchy theorem](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/HomologyCauchy.html#TauCeti.Contour.homologyCauchyTheorem)
text: a holomorphic function integrates to zero along a null-homologous closed contour. It comes with Cauchy formulas for all iterated derivatives.

name: [The classical residue theorem for cycles](https://taucetiproject.github.io/TauCeti/docs/TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/Cycle/Residue.html#TauCeti.Contour.Cycle.classicalResidueTheorem_nullHomologous)
text: when a null-homologous cycle avoids a finite pole set, its integral is `2πi` times the winding-weighted residue sum. The circle case is stated separately.

name: The Galois correspondence for pointed covers
text: every pointed connected cover of `(X, x₀)` is isomorphic over `X` to `UniversalCover x₀ / H` for exactly one subgroup `H`, with conjugacy classes for unpointed covers and normal subgroups for regular ones.

name: The monodromy equivalence
text: monodromy is an equivalence from covering spaces of `X` to functors from the fundamental groupoid to types, and over a path-connected base to `π₁(X, x₀)`-sets.

name: The fundamental group as fibre-functor automorphisms
text: `π₁(X, x₀)` is the automorphism group of the fibre functor over `x₀` on all covering spaces, while on finite covers the automorphism group is its profinite completion.

name: Existence of a simply connected cover
text: a path-connected, locally path-connected space is semilocally simply connected exactly when it admits a simply connected covering space, so the roadmap's standing hypothesis cannot be weakened.

name: The fundamental group of real projective space
text: `π₁(RPⁿ) ≅ ℤ/2` for `n ≥ 2` at any basepoint, resting on simple connectivity of higher spheres, with `RP¹` and `RP⁰` handled separately.

name: The orbit–cone correspondence for a regular fan
text: the cones of the fan correspond bijectively to the torus orbits of its realization, inclusion of cones reversing the closure order, and the closure of an orbit is the union of the orbits of the larger cones (Fan.coneEquivOrbitRelQuotient, Fan.closure_analyticConeOrbit).

name: The holomorphic torus action
text: the coordinate-free complex torus acts holomorphically on the realization, and every chart inclusion is equivariant.

name: Tate's theorem
text: for a finite group, cup product with a suitable degree-two class is an isomorphism in every Tate degree. For a class formation it gives tateIso, `Ĥ^r(U/V, ℤ) ≃ Ĥ^{r+2}(U/V, A^V)`, which is cup product with the fundamental class.

name: Norm limitation
text: a layer and its maximal abelian sublayer have the same norm subgroup. It is deduced from reciprocity, not from existence, which is what both existence layers need.

name: The Atkin–Lehner–Li theorem
